_comment: Sibling of decision_none_v3_empty_tally.json, pinning the POSITIVE direction of the 'none' exemption at schema_version 3. Under 'unanimous' or any other bound algorithm this exact empty tally DENIES the positive commitment (decision_empty_tally_binding.json); under 'none' it seals. The difference is the algorithm, not the schema_version. Two fixtures rather than one because a session resolves on its first accepted Commitment, so the two directions cannot share a transcript.
description: Decision Mode: 'none' is unaffected by the schema_version 3 empty-tally rule -- a positive commitment seals on zero ballots.

policy.description: No voting constraint, initiator-only commitment, schema_version 3. Pins that 'none' is exempt from the fail-closed empty-tally rule.

messages._comment: schema_version 3, zero ballots -- and it SEALS. 'none' enforces no voting constraint at any tally, so nothing in the Empty tally paragraph applies to it, and RFC-MACP-0007 6.2's face-value exception takes outcome_positive at face value with no decline guard. Compare decision_empty_tally_binding.json, which is the same empty tally under 'unanimous' at the same schema_version and is DENIED. The difference is the algorithm, not the version.

payload.reason: initiator-driven commitment under no voting constraint
